cves.description: A flaw was found in claircore's RPM package scanner. Crafted RPM header data in a container layer can cause an unchecked type assertion to panic the scanner. The panic is not recovered, causing the Clair indexer process to crash, leading to a denial of service.
cves.fix_suggestion:
📦 受影响组件：Red Hat Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security 4
🛠️ 修复建议：

2. 升级到厂商官方发布的最稳定安全版本
3. 检查官方安全公告获取补丁链接
